entries.evidence: The retained ordinary-C reconstruction has the same 0x280 padded size and all 38 relocation identities as January. The residual is confined to four independent instructions after tag_data_get_pointer: January loads animation_threads_debug before storing the returned event stream and masks the thread index before materializing &thread->event_stream; VC7 emits the store before the external-global load and materializes the field address before the mask. Making only animation_threads_debug static produces exact function bytes but a wrong 9-byte BSS owner with wrong symbol offsets/linkage. Making all three BSS definitions static restores the byte count but still gives wrong named offsets and removes the external _debug_recording owner required by hs_globals_external. Temporary-local and statement-order variants either enlarge the residual or change register allocation across the rest of the function. The natural, link-correct source is therefore parked rather than accepting a function-only false positive.

Target and candidate have equal 0x2A0 padded size and all 22 relocation identities. Prior grounded reconstruction leaves an ESI/EDX zero-register permutation for three death-statistic stores and one independent last-kill-time load scheduled seven bytes apart.

Target and candidate have equal 0x170 padded size and all 20 relocation identities/addresses. The remaining 11 normalized bytes are confined to the post-copy structure-field stores: VC7 chooses AX/CX for the type value, schedules the hardware-buffer reload at a different point, and moves one independent base-address store across the EDI restore. Broad declaration, field-order, barrier, helper, alias, qualifier, and topology matrices did not reproduce the target without regressing the exact prefix or relocation schedule.

Target and candidate have equal 0x160 padded size and all 24 relocation identities/addresses. The remaining eight normalized bytes are confined to the final four structure-field stores: the target reloads the hardware buffer into ECX before the offset/base stores, while VC7's current source reloads it into EAX after them. A preserved 160-case control-flow/barrier/field-order supersearch plus focused lifetime, alias, helper, qualifier, and initialization matrices found no legal-C form that changes only this schedule.

The gameplay inline-assembly transcription was removed under the house rule limiting sparse assembly to helper/math code. The retained ordinary-C reconstruction has the same 0x100 padded size and eight relocation identities as January. Five grounded C shapes were exhausted; the remaining packet difference is VC7 retaining the shared TRUE value in EBX/BL while the lawful source folds the four uses into immediate operands. The clean semantic C is therefore parked as a register-allocation residual rather than forcing exact bytes.

Audit and full inventory: research/asm_credited_functions_audit.md. Whole body is a single __asm block; no C remains. 2026-08-16 recovery attempt: expressible in C but a near-miss at 72/96. Semantically-correct C reaches 85 bytes off naively, 74 after moving the empty-needle return to the tail (the branch-polarity lever), and 72 with a while(*haystack) loop; prologue, csstrlen call, search loop and _strnicmp call all land correctly. Residue is a spill preference: January holds the first needle character in bl across the function and spills length into the dead needle parameter slot [ebp+0xc]; we keep length in ebx and spill the character to [ebp+0xf]. Measured inert: declaration order both ways, register on either/both locals, int/long/unsigned long length (int regresses to 103), length scoped inside the if, character hoisted out of the loop, continue- and while-form loops, length computed before the guard. Same spill class as the standing parks. Not replaced - swapping a byte-exact asm body for a 72-byte residual is not a recovery. See research/asm_credited_functions_audit.md. 2026-08-16 spill-flip attempt, refined: the 72-byte while(*haystack) form is STRUCTURALLY WRONG - it rotates the loop, duplicating the load/test at the back edge and forcing lea eax,[esi-1] instead of dec esi/mov eax,esi. The structurally correct form is the for(;;) at 74/96, whose loop body matches January instruction-for-instruction (load, inc, test, je, cmp, jne back-edge, strnicmp, test, jne back-edge, dec, return). Byte count is therefore the wrong metric here; 74 is closer than 72. With that structure fixed the residue is isolated to a single free-register contest: esi and edi hold haystack and needle in both builds, and exactly one of {first, length} can have ebx because both live ranges span a call (first across csstrlen, length across _strnicmp). January gives ebx to first (mov bl,[edi], cmp al,bl) and spills length into the dead needle slot [ebp+0xc]; we give ebx to length and spill first to [ebp+0xf] - which is also inside the dead needle slot, so both compilers reuse the same storage and differ only in which value wins the register. Additional inert levers measured this round: char/byte/unsigned char for the first character and the loop character, long/unsigned long/const long for the length, assignment inside the while condition, pointer-compare-before-increment, and length computed before the guard. Same free-register-preference class as the register-allocation parks; reachable in principle, lever not found. 2026-08-16 c2 debugger result (NEGATIVE, closes a line of investigation): built tools/c2dbg32/repro_stristr.c, a single-function TU reproducing the tie exactly (96B, ndiff 74, same mov ebx,eax for length and same spill of first to [ebp+0xf]), and breakpointed every mapped allocator site during its compile. The machinery runs - interference dispatch 0x1074d343 x6, relation 0x107091ae x8, overlap probe 0x10735a41 x5, interference test 0x1070943b x3, coalescing copy 0x10701961 x15, leaf-register write 0x10715873 x2, preference store 0x1075f5f2 x5, finalizer 0x107144cf x3 - but it never touches the registers in question: both leaf-register writes assign register byte 1, and ALL FIFTEEN coalescing copies propagate register byte 1 (ecx==1 at every hit). ebx/esi/edi are 3/6/7 zero-based and never appear. The mapped sites allocate the eax-family scratch class; the callee-saved assignment and the spill choice are made in a pass that is still unmapped. Further breakpoint work on these VAs therefore cannot reach this tie (nor the sibling register-mirror and spill parks). Progress needs the callee-saved/spill pass located from scratch - the entry point is the code that decides a live range is memory-resident, not the code that stamps [node+0x28]. See tools/c2dbg32/IR_LAYOUT.md. 2026-08-16 CORRECTION to this entry's earlier c2 claims: 0x10715873 does NOT write a physical register. Four probes differing only in the C type of the spilled locals show the byte it stamps into node[+0x28] is uniform across every node in a compile and tracks operand size - char->1, short->2, int->3, __int64->4 (13/13/13/7 hits, one distinct value each). It is an operand WIDTH class, not a register; thirteen simultaneously-live values cannot share one register. This also resolves the 'discrepancy' noted during the original record_kill work (rwprobe used short fields, every write showed al=2 while the code used ecx) - that was the width of a short, not a register quirk. Consequently the earlier 'read the register write' and 'traced the preferred-register argument' results for this function are WITHDRAWN: the physical-register assignment site and the spill decision are both still unlocated. The mechanism narrative (both candidate registers free, outcome set upstream) stands on the instruction-level evidence, but no compiler-internal site has been confirmed to make it. See tools/c2dbg32/IR_LAYOUT.md.

Audit and full inventory: research/asm_credited_functions_audit.md. __declspec(naked): no C body exists at all. 2026-08-16 recovery attempt: PROVABLY not expressible in C. The argument registers are live on entry (push eax with no preceding load) and the symbol is cdecl-decorated (_code_00148xxx, no @N) while the body does callee cleanup (ret 4). No standard convention produces that pair - measured: compiling the same body as __stdcall emits _code_00148xxx@4 and stops matching the target name. The only C route is VC7's private convention for a static with in-TU call sites, and these have no references anywhere in the tree, so an unreferenced static is eliminated. Park is now backed by proof rather than judgement.

Target and candidate have equal 0x190 padded size and all 26 relocation identities/addresses. They are instruction-identical through +0x159 and differ in exactly one normalized byte: VC7 directs the final failure JNE to a second byte-identical bitmap->hardware_format = NULL / return TRUE epilogue, while January directs it to the first epilogue. More than 50 ordinary-C control-flow shapes covering shared and split returns, branch polarity, goto topology, success materialization, and local lifetimes either preserve this one-byte duplicate-epilogue branch-threading choice or regress earlier exact code. The retained source is the plain semantic form; no asm, volatile/register forcing, pragmas, barriers, undefined behavior, byte patch, or comparator exception is used.

Fuzzy-parked under the current house rule after the complete E1-E50 source-shape corpus, two compatible VC7 builds, all committed/dirty LRA bodies, 1,092 rebuilt artifacts, the later Claude naming/line-anchor audit, and the open Marathon source were reviewed. January carries a zero through the allocator loop and duplicates the initial pass/deletion stores; VC7 instead merges/rematerializes them, leaving the honest C 32 padded bytes short with identical four relocation destinations but addresses 0x13/0x5F/0x83/0x88 versus 0x13/0x6B/0x89/0x8E. The only 400-byte form used _ReadWriteBarrier() as a codegen anchor and is rejected as fake compiler steering. Its barrier-free ordinary-C remainder stayed 368 bytes and worsened normalized distance from 320 to 331 bytes (SHA f719c088...), so the simpler coherent early-return source is retained. Reopen only for authoritative January source/locals, a real donor with the same loop-carried-zero dependency, a compatible original C2/QFE, or a newly proven meaningful C topology outside the exhausted families.
